notes: Performance pass on the player. It was rebuilding a full diagnostics snapshot twice every second for the whole movie even with the info panel closed, and re-sending the video length to the interface twice a second even though it never changes. Both are gone, and while the controls are hidden the playhead updates at half rate since nothing is showing it. Together that cuts the background chatter during playback by about 75 percent, which should mean less stutter and less memory pressure on the box.
